description_en: Enables or disables the Static Page Caching policy for a website
description_zh: 设置网站业务静态页面缓存的开关状态
name: ModifyWebCacheSwitch

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to configure the Static Page Caching policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all the domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
要设置静态页面缓存的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the Static Page Caching policy for a website. Valid values:

1: enables the policy.
0: disables the policy
parameters.help_zh:
设置静态页面缓存的开关状态。取值：

1：表示开启。
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: enable
